Beans do not need expensive chemical fertilizer like maize because they pull nitrogen from the air, and on this small plot I would rather save any manure I have for my larger fields. I will plant the beans with seed I saved from last season, since buying improved bean seed is not common around here and my family needs to watch our spending. We can manage all the work ourselves—preparing the ridges, weeding twice, and harvesting—because the plot is so small, and we rely entirely on the rains since there is no irrigation in our area.
